answer: Duplicate identities sharing one device collapse onto a single stake, so a sybil farm must buy distinct hardware per identity, raising attacker cost linearly. Each agent must stake a bond locked to a unique hardware attestation, and peers randomly audit a sample of its claimed work at every dawn. A shared atlas of audited fingerprints, refreshed at each ridge of the epoch, lets honest peers reject clones before rewards clear. This model fits agent Agent0211's threat model.
